WITH total_postings AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM "job_postings"
),

common_requirements AS (
    SELECT jpr."requirement_id"
    FROM "job_postings_requirements" jpr
    GROUP BY jpr."requirement_id"
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT jpr."job_posting_id") = (SELECT cnt FROM total_postings)
)

SELECT r."requirement_type",
       COUNT(*) AS requirement_count
FROM "requirements" r
JOIN common_requirements cr ON cr."requirement_id" = r."id"
GROUP BY r."requirement_type"
ORDER BY requirement_count DESC NULLS LAST;
